features.title: Scaffold static site + test runner
acceptance_criteria: index.html loads with no build step on GitHub Pages
package.json with npm run dev / npm test / npm run check:content
node --test runs at least one sample test
Hash routes #Map #Learn #Drill #Prep #Cards render placeholders
Periodic-table tray with trend heat maps

features.title: Coverage check against external source manifest
acceptance_criteria: npm run check:content reads a manifest from $MM_SOURCES (outside the repo) listing course files with chapter and status
Fails if any in-scope manifest entry is not mapped to at least one lesson or problem set via an id in content/coverage.json
content/coverage.json holds only manifest ids and lesson ids, with no source text or file names
Skips cleanly with a warning when MM_SOURCES is unset (e.g. CI)

features.title: Local OCR helper for image-only source PDFs
acceptance_criteria: Script writes OCR text into $MM_SOURCES only, never into the repo
Ask the owner before adding any paid OCR service

features.title: Lesson + problem schema and grader core
acceptance_criteria: content/schema.json defines lesson {id,ch,openstax_section,guide_line,steps[],worked_example,similar_problem{q,hint,answer},sources[]}
Problem generator returns {q,a,why,hints[],check}
grade() handles numeric tolerance, sci notation, sig figs, units
Unit tests for grader

features.title: Drill: electron configuration (element → configuration, incl. ions, Cr/Cu)

Adaptive: misses are re-queued

Adaptive: misses are re-queued
